model_annotation: Figure 3: Inter-annotator agreement compared to sample-level ambiguity standard deviation and sample-level maximum ambiguity values. The figure displays two bar charts. The left chart, labeled "Ambiguity Std," shows the Fleiss' Kappa values for different standard deviation values (0.47, 0.62, 0.94), with corresponding bars of 0.88, 0.46, and 0.03. The right chart, labeled "Max Ambiguity," shows the Fleiss' Kappa values for different maximum ambiguity values (1, 2, 3), with corresponding bars of 0.89, 0.46, and 0.23.
